name: Orbital Economy v7.4 SKELETON task 002 (symmetry, partial)

add_elements.name: Reverse A Wage
add_elements.description: Mode 4 override wage for A; equals A Wage (A conditions do not change in Mode 4).

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Test 4 Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, [Reverse A Wage], [A Wage])

replace_formulas.name: A Metal Unit Cost
replace_formulas.value: [A Ore per Metal] * [A Ore Price] + [A Energy per Metal] * [A Effective Energy Price] + [A Labor per Metal] * [A Effective Wage]

replace_formulas.name: A Power Active Generation Capacity
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Capital Lifecycle Enabled] = 1, [A Power Active Generation Capital], [A Power Installed Generation Capacity]) * IfThenElse([Test 11 Generation Capacity Shock Active] = 1, IfThenElse([A Test 11 Generation Shock Applies] = 1, [Generation Capacity Shock Factor], 1), IfThenElse([Test 6 Electronics Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, IfThenElse([A Test 6 Headroom Applies] = 1, [Legacy Advantage Test Power Headroom Multiplier], 1), IfThenElse([Test 4 Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, IfThenElse([A Test 4 Headroom Applies] = 1, [Legacy Advantage Test Power Headroom Multiplier], 1), 1)))

replace_formulas.name: B Power Active Generation Capacity
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Capital Lifecycle Enabled] = 1, [B Power Active Generation Capital], [B Power Installed Generation Capacity]) * IfThenElse([Test 11 Generation Capacity Shock Active] = 1, IfThenElse([B Test 11 Generation Shock Applies] = 1, [Generation Capacity Shock Factor], 1), IfThenElse([Test 6 Electronics Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, IfThenElse([B Test 6 Headroom Applies] = 1, [Legacy Advantage Test Power Headroom Multiplier], 1), IfThenElse([Test 4 Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, IfThenElse([B Test 4 Headroom Applies] = 1, [Legacy Advantage Test Power Headroom Multiplier], 1), 1)))
